description: This file defines an abstract class 'AuditModel' used as a base entity for tracking creation and update timestamps in a JPA-based application. It leverages JPA annotations, Spring Data auditing, and Jackson annotations for JSON serialization.

classes.name: AuditModel
classes.description: An abstract base class for entities that require audit information about creation and modification timestamps. It is configured to be a mapped superclass with automatic auditing and JSON serialization properties.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the entity was created.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the entity was last updated.
